abilities.name: Entrenched Crews
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Arkanaut Company units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle round, if the target has not been set up this battle round and while it has not moved this turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of attacks that target that unit.

abilities.name: Extra Rappel Anchors
abilities.effect: Friendly Grundstok Gunhaulers can transport up to 2 friendly Kharadron Overlords Infantry units instead of 1 and with a combined model count of up to 6 instead of 5 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: Special Procurement
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Unique Kharadron Overlords Hero that does not have an artefact of power.
abilities.effect: Give that Hero 1 artefact of power from the 'Inventions of the Sky-ports' or the 'Ingenious Innovations'.

abilities.name: Gritty Fortune-Hunters
abilities.effect: Friendly Vongrim Harpoon Crew and Vongrim Salvagers units have Ward (6+) while they are contesting an objective.

abilities.name: Skyvessel Cover
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Kharadron Overlords Infantry units that have not charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 6" of a friendly Arkanaut Ironclad or Arkanaut Frigate that has not charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Flying High
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Skyvessel that is in a regiment from which no units have been deployed, then pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are in its regiment.
abilities.effect: Set up all of those units in reserve in the clouds. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Descend from the Clouds
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Skyvessel in the clouds to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Set up that Skyvessel anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up all other units that were set up in the clouds with that Skyvessel wholly within 6" of it and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Transport Skyfarers
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase, Reaction: You declared a non-Charge Move ability for a friendly Skyvessel
abilities.declare: The Skyvessel using that Move ability
abilities.effect: Pick a number of units up to that Skyvessel's Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are wholly within 6" of it and not in combat to be the targets. Units that have been transported this turn cannot be targets. Remove the targets from the battlefield. After the Skyvessel ends its move, you must set up each target unit on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that Skyvessel and not in combat. Those units have been transported. A unit cannot use Charge abilities if it was transported in the same turn.

abilities.name: The Flagship
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Skyvessel to be the target. The target can be in reserve.
abilities.effect: The target has the Flagship keyword for the rest of the battle. If the target does not have a Great Endrinwork, give the target 1 Great Endrinwork. Designer's Note: *This Great Endrinwork is given to the unit during the deployment phase not during army composition.*

abilities.name: Scything Blade
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see 'The Pendulum Swings'). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Pendulum Swings
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot use Charge or Fight abilities. In addition, when this Manifestation moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing

summon.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulumon the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Mechanisms of Time
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If there are any friendly Wizards within 3" of this Manifestation, pick 1 of the following effects: *Increase Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation. *Decrease Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Wizards while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Chronomantic Cogs
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Dancing Blades
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this Manifestation's attacks.

summon.name: Summon Quicksilver Swords
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Quicksilver Swords endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Harbinger of Horror
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this Manifestation's shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of models in the target unit that were slain this phase, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

summon.name: Summon Horrorghast
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Horrorghast endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Horrorghast endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Traverse the Tides of Death
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Infantry Wizard Hero within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield within 3" of this Manifestation and not in combat. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Lauchon the Soulseeker
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Translocation
abilities.effect: Pick a part of this Manifestation, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Ensnaring Soul-drain
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a Move ability while it is within 9" of any parts of this Manifestation, the effects of the 'Fly' ability do not apply to that unit. Enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of either part of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Shards of Valagharr
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Shards of Valagharr endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Shards of Valagharr endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Shards of Valagharr endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Deathly Passage
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of one part of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the other part of this Manifestation and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

summon.name: Summon Soulscream Bridge

summon.effect: Set up a Soulscream Bridge wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulscream Bridge has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Devourer of Magics
abilities.effect: If this Manifestation destroyed any enemy Manifestations this turn, Heal (6) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Arcane Predator
abilities.effect: You can add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this Manifestation, to a maximum of 3, while it is within 18" of any enemy Manifestations, but if you do so, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of an enemy Manifestation.

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation is targeted by the 'Banish Manifestation' ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

summon.name: Summon Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Morbid Detonation
abilities.declare: You must, and can only, use this ability if this unit has 6 maelstrom points. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this Manifestation is destroyed.

abilities.name: Necrotic Vortex
abilities.effect: Give this Manifestation 1 maelstrom point each time: • This Manifestation is set up. • A unit successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this Manifestation. • A model is slain within 12" of this Manifestation. This Manifestation can have a maximum of 6 maelstrom points at once.

summon.name: Summon Malevolent Maelstrom
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: End Given Form
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Pull of the Nadir
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for friendly and enemy units while they are within 3" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Purple Sun of Shyish
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Bound for the Great Oubliette
abilities.declare: For each part of this Manifestation, you can pick an enemy unit within 3" of that part to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • Subtract a number of inches equal to the roll from the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

summon.name: Summon Soulsnare Shackles
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulsnare Shackles endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: Pulled to the Grave
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can pick an enemy unit that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the target. Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Suffocating Gravetide
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Tendrils of Light and Shadow
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of either part of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play. Each time this Manifestation moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other. Each part of this Manifestation is armed with Tendrils of Light and Shadow.

summon.name: Summon Geminids of Uhl-Gysh
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizardto cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot be targeted by shooting attacks. In addition, a unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is impossible to draw a straight line from a model in the attacking unit to a model in the target unit without that line passing across this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Prismatic Palisade
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Prismatic Palisade endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Prismatic Palisade wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Arcane Passage
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Wizard within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: The next time the target uses a non-Summon Spell ability this phase, add 1 to the casting value of that spell. When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this Manifestation instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this Manifestation instead of to the caster for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.

summon.name: Summon Umbral Spellportal
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Umbral Spellportal endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Umbral Spellportal wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. An Umbral Spellportal has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Restored Vigour
abilities.effect: Heal (3) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Bounteous Healing
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Heal (3) the target.

summon.name: Summon Emerald Lifeswarm
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Ravening Hunger
abilities.declare: If this Manifestation charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

weapons.name: Burning Breath
weapons.ability: Shoot in Combat, Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)

abilities.name: Burning Up
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation uses a Shoot ability, after that ability has been resolved, allocate 1 damage point to this Manifestation (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

abilities.name: Celestium Burst Grenade
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Voidstone Orb
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a Spell ability for a Wizard within 30" of this unit
abilities.effect: That spell is unbound.

abilities.name: Blazebeard and Sons Bamboozling Flakgun
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a Charge ability for a unit within 12" of this unit.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 dice in that charge roll. Then, make a bamboozling flak roll of D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the value on the dice, remove that dice from the charge roll.

abilities.name: Bold as Brass
abilities.effect: Add 5 to this unit's control score.

abilities.name: Combat Grafter
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can use 2 Fight abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has Strike-last for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Shrewd Opportunist
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 other friendly Kharadron Overlords non-Hero Infantry units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can immediately use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: Artycle 15, Point 4
abilities.effect: • Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's combat attacks that target an enemy unit that has Fly. • Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks that target an enemy unit that does not have Fly.

abilities.name: Artycle 20, Amendment 2
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Enemy Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target's attacks cannot score critical hits for the rest of the turn (treat them as regular hits instead).

abilities.name: Artycle 25, Point 6
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Friendly Kharadron Overlords Heroes have Ward (5+) while they are within this unit's combat range.

abilities.name: Repair Routines
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Skyvessel within 3" of this terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a repair roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if there is a friendly Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit or Endrinmaster with Endrinharness within 3" of this terrain feature. On a 4+, Heal (3) the target.

abilities.name: Release the Auto-Endrins
abilities.effect: Set up a friendly Nullifier Auto-Endrin, Stuncloud Auto-Endrin and Grudgeblast Auto-Endrin (see the Auto-Endrin warscroll) on the battlefield within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Endrinworks Outpost
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Auto-Endrin or replacement Auto-Endrin that has been removed from the battlefield to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a manufacturing roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if there is a friendly Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit or Endrinmaster with Endrinharness within 3" of this terrain feature. On a 4+, set up a replacement Auto-Endrin on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Aetheric Augmentation
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Arkanaut Company unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Atmospheric Isolation
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units within 9" of this unit.

abilities.name: Read the Winds
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Skyvessel or Auto-Endrin within this unit's combat range and that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if the target is a Skyvessel, you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Aethersight
abilities.effect: This unit can use Unbind abilities as if it had Wizard (1).

abilities.name: The Admiral's Flagship
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Flagship wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, each time the target uses a Shoot ability, you can re-roll 1 of the hit rolls made for that ability.

abilities.name: 'Bring Every Gun to Bear!'
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Skyvessel wholly within 24" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's ranged weapons.

abilities.name: Command the Fleet
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly Skyvessels wholly within 24" of this unit that are not in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can use a Run ability and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: First Rule of Grungsson
abilities.declare: Pick up to 2 other friendly Skyfarer units within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Moustache-mounted Aetherblasters
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Advisory Role
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly Skyfarers units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that target for the rest of the turn: *Seek New Prospects:* Add 5 to the target's control score. *Don't Argue With the Wind:* Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target. *There's No Trading With Some People:* The target can use a Retreat ability and still use Shoot abilities later in the turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by Retreat abilities.

abilities.name: I'm Watching You
abilities.effect: Give this unit D3 vexed points.

abilities.name: Alright, Listen Up
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly non-Hero Kharadron Overlords unit, pick a visible enemy unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, choose to spend either 3 or 6 vexed points.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply to the target for the rest of the turn: • *Do you see how fast they are going?!:* If you spent 3 vexed points, subtract D3 from the target's Move characteristic. If you spent 6 vexed points, halve the target's Move characteristic. • *Those weapons are against regulation!:* If you spent 3 vexed points, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's combat attacks. If you spent 6 vexed points, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons and subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's combat attacks.

abilities.name: Captain of the Aelsling
abilities.declare: Pick an Arkanaut Frigate in this unit's regiment to be the target. This unit can use this ability while in reserve, and the target can also be in reserve.
abilities.effect: The target has the Aelsling keyword. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target's Boarding Weapons for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Auxiliary Skyhook
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Monster in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • Subtract 1 from wound rolls made for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: She Can Handle It!
abilities.effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for the Aelsling while it is wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Combat Engineers

abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly Endrinriggers unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, combat attacks made by the targets against enemy units that charged this turn have Crit (2 Hits).

abilities.name: Mobile Repairs
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Skyvessel or Zontari Endrin Dock within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, Heal (3) the target.

abilities.name: 'Aye Aye, Captain!'

abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn: • The target can use a Retreat or Run ability and still use Shoot abilities later in the turn. • No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by Retreat abilities.

abilities.name: Mobile Repairs
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Skyvessel or Zontari Endrin Dock within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, Heal (3) the target.

abilities.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly Skyfarer units have Ward (5+) against mortal damage inflicted by Spell abilities, Prayer abilities and abilities used by Manifestations.

abilities.name: Nullsuit
abilities.effect: Double the Damage characteristic of this unit's weapons for attacks that target Priests, Wizards, or Manifestations.

abilities.name: Diligent Researcher
abilities.effect: Each time your opponent spends any rage dice as part of the 'Eruption of Fury' ability, after that ability has been resolved, if this unit is not in combat, it can move up to XD6", where X is the number of rage dice spent. It cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Customised Nullsuit
abilities.effect: • This unit can use Unbind and Banish abilities as if it had Wizard (1). • Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: Grizzled Buccaneers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+: • This unit can immediately use a Shoot ability as if it were your shooting phase but all of its attacks must target the target enemy unit. • For the rest of the phase, this unit's Privateer Heavy Weapons have Shoot in Combat.

abilities.name: Assault Boat
abilities.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it is in combat or has used a Run or Retreat ability this turn. Pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity that are wholly within 6" of it, are not in combat and that have not charged this turn to be the targets. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll and must end the move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so: • Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within this unit's combat range. The targets can be set up in combat. • This unit and the targets have charged, and the targets cannot use another Core ability this phase. • Pick up to 1 of the targets to have Strike-first for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Heavy Sky Ordnance is 3.

abilities.name: Medium Bomb Racks
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have Fly and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.effect: This unit can transport up to 2 friendly Kharadron Overlords Infantry units with a combined model count of up to 12 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: Incoming!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Incoming!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Great Sky Ordnance is 4.

abilities.name: Heavy Bomb Racks
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have Fly and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.effect: This unit can transport up to 3 friendly Kharadron Overlords Infantry units with a combined model count of up to 22 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: Emergency Field Repairs
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Skyvessel or Zontari Endrin Dock within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a field repairs roll of D6 for each model in this unit. For each 4-5, Heal (1) the target. For each 6, Heal (2) the target.

abilities.name: We're Working Here
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, if this unit has not charged in the same turn, the following cumulative effects apply depending on your fury level. **1+ *Irked*: This unit's Aethermatic Saws have Crit (Auto-wound). 4+ *Exasperated*: This unit has Ward (5+). 7 *Incensed*:** Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Long-line Slings
abilities.effect: When you use the 'Transport Skyfarers' ability for this unit, you can pick units in combat to be targets.

abilities.name: Light Bomb Racks
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have Fly and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 4 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.effect: This unit can transport 1 friendly Kharadron Overlords Infantry units with a model count of up to 5 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: Aethershot Overwatch
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Attack Squadron
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of any other friendly Grundstok Gunhaulers, it can use Shoot abilities even if it used the 'Run' ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Fighter Vessels
abilities.effect: If this unit used a Shoot ability this phase, this unit can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.effect: This unit cannot transport any friendly units.

abilities.name: Specialist Grundstok Ammunition
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit
abilities.declare: Pick Shieldbreaker ammunition or Thunderdrakk ammunition.
abilities.effect: If all of the attacks made for that Shoot ability target the same enemy unit, after that Shoot ability has been resolved, roll a dice and add the number of damage points allocated to the target by that Shoot ability. If the roll is higher than the target's Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked: *Shieldbreaker:* Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn. *Thunderdrakk:* That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Timed Charges
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • This unit can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

abilities.name: Aethermatic Anatomiser
abilities.declare: If this unit's Bjorgen Thundrik is on the battlefield, pick an objective within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+: • If the target is controlled by either player, that player loses control of that objective. • The target cannot be contested until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Light Endrinpacks
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6" but must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Spotter's Flaregun
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 9" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effects for the rest of the turn: • Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Skyfarer units that target a unit that is contesting the target objective. • Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Vongrim Salvagers and Vongrim Harpoon Crew units for attacks that target a unit that is contesting the target objective
